svg.aria-label: Task 2.1: the new incident TCK-10561 at A. Datum Corporation, New and unclassified: no new recovery points since Saturday, the cloud storage allowance used up after a 2019 to 2024 drawing archive was copied. True matches: KB0023, RBA-2201 cloud vault storage quota exceeded, with a history of 10 tickets, all P3 Medium; and the open ticket TCK-10521 at Trey Research with the same quota error. Decoys: KB0012 and KB0013, a failed job for Platinum and Gold or Silver and Bronze customers; KB0033, slow backups after vault encryption; KB0036, large .pst files in backups; KB0039, a device offline; KB0007, the RBA-1043 snapshot timeout; and TCK-10532, an A. Datum device that is offline. Task 2.2: Woodgrove Bank has 6 open tickets, the most of any customer, the next has 3; three are the same recurring issue, Remote Access dropping every hour, KB0058: TCK-10548, TCK-10553 and TCK-10518; the others are TCK-10531, TCK-10543 and TCK-10513. Task 2.3: the recommendation for TCK-10561 is category Backup and Recovery, subcategory Storage quota, priority P3 Medium with a 32 business hour target, technician Priya Raman, TECH-01, citing the pattern that all 10 KB0023 tickets were P3 Medium and handled by Priya Raman. Task 2.4: SLA risk in business hours, Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00 UTC: breached TCK-10501 Tailspin Toys 6.0 hours over and TCK-10512 Northwind Traders 1.5 hours over; near breach TCK-10540 Contoso Pharmaceuticals 0.5 hours left, TCK-10524 Humongous Insurance 1.0 hour left and TCK-10504 Bellows College 2.0 hours left; every other open ticket has 6.0 hours or more.
